faqs.question: Can I return something?
faqs.answer: Only if it arrived broken. Record a continuous unboxing video, starting before you open the package, and send it within 24 hours of delivery: without it, a return or refund cannot be processed. See our [shipping & returns policy](/shipping).

faqs.question: I ordered the wrong size. Can I swap it?
faqs.answer: Message us as soon as you notice. If the order has not shipped yet, we will simply swap it before it leaves.
